rule.quote: Prior therapy with a topoisomerase 1 inhibitor-based antibody drug conjugate.
rule.why: The record says they had an antibody-drug conjugate with a topoisomerase payload; the trial excludes exactly that.

rule.quote: Prior radiotherapy to the study cancer (local recurrence).
rule.why: The record says they finished radiation to the chest three months ago, as part of their one line of treatment for this cancer; the trial excludes prior radiotherapy to it.

rule.quote: Participants must have no prior systemic anti-tumor therapy for locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC.
rule.why: The record says one line of treatment since the cancer became advanced; the trial requires none.

rule.quote: Must have disease with evidence of KRAS G12C mutation.
rule.why: The record says KRAS was tested and none found; the trial requires a KRAS G12C mutation.

rule.quote: harbors an ALK, ROS1, NTRK1, NTRK2, or NTRK3 gene rearrangement by protocol specified tests
rule.why: The record says ALK, ROS1 and NTRK were tested and none found; every part of the trial requires one of them.

rule.quote: One to two prior lines of therapy including an anti-PD-1/anti-PD(L)-1 agent and platinum-based chemotherapy.
rule.why: The record says they've had neither immunotherapy nor platinum chemotherapy; the trial requires both.

rule.quote: Patients must have a HER2 amplified solid tumor except breast cancer.
rule.why: The record says HER2 was tested and none found, extra copies included; the trial requires HER2 amplification.

rule.quote: Somatic activating mutation in EGFR in pre-treatment tumor biopsy/ cytology from pleural fluid or cfDNA
rule.why: The record says EGFR was tested and none found; the trial requires an activating EGFR mutation.

rule.quote: History of, or known, central nervous system (CNS) disease involvement
rule.why: The record says the cancer has spread to the brain; the trial excludes any known involvement of the brain or spine.

rule.quote: Somatic activating mutation in EGFR in pre-treatment tumor biopsy/ cytology from pleural fluid or cfDNA
rule.why: The record says EGFR was tested and none found; the trial requires an activating EGFR mutation.

rule.quote: previously untreated and pathologically confirmed resectable clinical Stage II, IIIA, or IIIB (N2) non-small cell lung cancer
rule.why: The record says surgery can't remove it; the trial requires resectable disease.

rule.quote: not suitable for curative intent radical surgery or radiation therapy.
rule.why: The record says it can be removed with surgery; the trial requires disease not suitable for curative surgery.

rule.quote: Kirsten rat sarcoma viral oncogene homolog \[KRAS\] G12D mutation
rule.why: The record says KRAS was tested and none found; the trial requires a KRAS G12D mutation.

rule.quote: Patients must have a HER2 amplified solid tumor except breast cancer.
rule.why: The record says HER2 was tested and none found, extra copies included; the trial requires HER2 amplification.

rule.quote: Histologically or cytologically confirmed locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor with a documented ALK rearrangement or activating ALK mutation.
rule.why: The record says ALK was tested and none found; every part of the trial requires an ALK rearrangement or mutation.

rule.quote: Have completed 3-4 cycles of chemoimmunotherapy, without evidence of progressive disease.
rule.why: The record says the cancer grew during or after immunotherapy; the trial requires chemo-immunotherapy without progression.

rule.quote: harbors an ALK, ROS1, NTRK1, NTRK2, or NTRK3 gene rearrangement by protocol specified tests
rule.why: The record says ALK, ROS1 and NTRK were tested and none found; every part of the trial requires one of them.

rule.quote: Histologically or cytologically documented non-squamous NSCLC.
rule.why: The record says squamous cell; the trial requires non-squamous.

rule.quote: ECOG 0 or 1
rule.why: The record says ECOG 2 (up more than half the day, can't work); the trial requires 0 or 1.

rule.quote: harbors an ALK, ROS1, NTRK1, NTRK2, or NTRK3 gene rearrangement by protocol specified tests
rule.why: The record says ALK, ROS1 and NTRK were tested and none found; every part of the trial requires one of them.
